name: Seattle
blurb: From Capitol Hill condos to Ballard craftsmans and West Seattle view homes, Seattle prices move block by block. We help you read the micro-market before you write an offer or set a list price.

name: Bellevue
blurb: Eastside demand runs on schools, commute, and tech employment. Bellevue rewards preparation: clean pre-inspection, sharp pricing, and a plan for multiple-offer situations.
points: Strategy for competitive and multiple-offer markets

name: Kent
blurb: Kent offers more space for the money and a strong rental base, which makes it a common first home and first investment for our clients.

name: Tacoma

points: Value comparison against King County options
